text:
Ethanol is made industrially by the fermentation of glucose or by the catalytic addition of steam to
ethene.
Which statement describes an advantage of fermentation compared to catalytic addition?
A
Ethanol is the only product of fermentation.
B
Fermentation uses a batch process but catalytic addition is continuous.
C
Fermentation uses a higher temperature than catalytic addition.
D
Fermentation uses a renewable resource.

options.label: A
options.text: Ethanol is the only product of fermentation.

options.label: B
options.text: Fermentation uses a batch process but catalytic addition is continuous.

options.label: C
options.text: Fermentation uses a higher temperature than catalytic addition.
